answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 120 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an inlet bet on surviving 120 epochs of grading, and every signal settlement recomputes the pearl schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
